grammar_title: 谈论将来:be going to / will / 现在进行时表将来
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 2 Discovering Useful Structures:Talk about your future travel plans(将来时表达)。

points.point: be going to(计划打算 + 有迹象的预测)
points.overview: be going to do 表示已定的计划/打算,或根据现有迹象作出的预测(Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.)。

points.point: will(将来 / 临时决定 / 预测)
points.overview: will do 表示对将来的预测、说话当下做出的临时决定、承诺或主动提议(I will help you.)。

points.point: 现在进行时表将来(已确定的安排)
points.overview: be doing 表示按计划/时间表已确定、近期就要发生的安排,常带将来时间状语(We are leaving tomorrow.)。

questions.stem: "Look at those dark clouds! It ____ rain soon."
questions.explanation: 有迹象(乌云)→ be going to 预测,主语 it 用 is going to。

questions.stem: "We ____ visit Peru next summer; we've already booked the flight."
questions.explanation: 已定计划 → be going to,主语 we 用 are going to。

questions.stem: "She ____ apply for a visa tomorrow."
questions.explanation: 打算做的事 → is going to apply。

questions.stem: "Be careful! That box ____ fall."
questions.explanation: 看到迹象作预测 → is going to fall。

questions.stem: "They ____ rent a car for the trip."
questions.explanation: 计划的否定 → are not going to rent。

questions.stem: "____ you going to pack tonight?"
questions.explanation: be going to 一般疑问,主语 you → Are you going to。

questions.stem: "I ____ hike to Machu Picchu; I've planned it for months."
questions.explanation: 长期计划 → am going to hike。

questions.stem: "The sky is clear, so it ____ be a fine day."
questions.explanation: 据迹象预测 → is going to be。

questions.stem: "What ____ you going to do in Lima?"
questions.explanation: be going to 特殊疑问,主语 you → are you going to do。

questions.stem: "He ____ study Spanish before the trip."
questions.explanation: 打算 → is going to study。

questions.stem: "Look, the train ____ leave! Hurry up!"
questions.explanation: 眼前迹象 → is going to leave。

questions.stem: "We ____ stay in a small hotel near the castle."
questions.explanation: 已定安排/计划 → are going to stay。

questions.stem: "My parents ____ travel by train, not by plane."
questions.explanation: 复数主语 parents → are going to travel。

questions.stem: "There are so many clouds; I think it ____ snow."
questions.explanation: 迹象预测 → is going to snow。

questions.stem: "Are they going to ____ the old town tomorrow?"
questions.explanation: be going to + 动词原形 explore。

questions.stem: "I'm tired, so I ____ have an early night."
questions.explanation: 打算 → am going to have。

questions.stem: "This bridge looks weak; it ____ break one day."
questions.explanation: 据迹象预测 → is going to break。

questions.stem: "We ____ not going to miss the sunrise."
questions.explanation: be going to 否定,主语 we → are not going to miss。

questions.stem: "She ____ buy some gifts for her family."
questions.explanation: 打算 → is going to buy。

questions.stem: "They ____ build a new airport here next year."
questions.explanation: 复数主语已定计划 → are going to build。

questions.stem: "Don't worry — I ____ help you carry the bags."
questions.explanation: 当下临时决定/主动帮忙 → I will help。

questions.stem: "Maybe the weather ____ be better tomorrow."
questions.explanation: 对将来的预测 → will be。

questions.stem: "I think you ____ love the view from the top."
questions.explanation: I think + will 预测 → will love。

questions.stem: "— The phone is ringing. — OK, I ____ answer it."
questions.explanation: 说话当下临时决定 → I will answer。

questions.stem: "He probably ____ arrive late because of the traffic."
questions.explanation: probably + 预测 → will arrive。

questions.stem: "I promise I ____ send you a postcard."
questions.explanation: 承诺 → I will send。

questions.stem: "In the future, more people ____ travel to space."
questions.explanation: 对将来的预测 → will travel。

questions.stem: "Perhaps we ____ never know who built it."
questions.explanation: perhaps + 预测 → will never know。

questions.stem: "____ you pass me the map, please?"
questions.explanation: 礼貌请求 → Will you pass…?

questions.stem: "If it rains, we ____ stay in the hotel."
questions.explanation: 条件句主句用 will → will stay。

questions.stem: "That bag is heavy. — Don't worry, I ____ carry it for you."
questions.explanation: 当下主动提议 → I will carry。

questions.stem: "I'm sure the trip ____ be amazing."
questions.explanation: I'm sure + 预测 → will be。

questions.stem: "She ____ probably book the accommodation online."
questions.explanation: probably 预测 → will book。

questions.stem: "Scientists believe robots ____ change how we travel."
questions.explanation: believe + 预测 → will change。

questions.stem: "— I can't open this. — Here, I ____ do it for you."
questions.explanation: 临时决定 → I will do it。

questions.stem: "One day this small town ____ become a big city."
questions.explanation: 对将来的预测 → will become。

questions.stem: "We hope the weather ____ stay fine all week."
questions.explanation: hope + 预测 → will stay。

questions.stem: "Take an umbrella — it ____ probably rain later."
questions.explanation: probably 预测 → will rain。

questions.stem: "Don't worry about the tickets; I ____ book them tonight."
questions.explanation: 当下决定/承诺 → I will book。

questions.stem: "I believe you ____ enjoy every minute of the journey."
questions.explanation: believe + 预测 → will enjoy。

questions.stem: "We ____ to Peru next Monday; the tickets are booked."
questions.explanation: 已定安排+将来时间 → 现在进行时表将来 are flying。

questions.stem: "I ____ my grandparents this weekend."
questions.explanation: 近期已定安排 → am visiting。

questions.stem: "The train ____ at six tomorrow morning."
questions.explanation: 时间表/已定 → is leaving(也可一般现在时,这里选进行时)。

questions.stem: "They ____ in a hotel near the beach next week."
questions.explanation: 已定安排 → are staying。

questions.stem: "What ____ you ____ this evening?"
questions.explanation: 问近期安排 → are you doing。

questions.stem: "She ____ a guided tour at nine o'clock tomorrow."
questions.explanation: 已约定时间 → is taking。

questions.stem: "We ____ the castle this afternoon, so let's hurry."
questions.explanation: 今天下午已定 → are visiting。

questions.stem: "My friends ____ me at the airport tonight."
questions.explanation: 已约定 → are meeting。

questions.stem: "I'm not ____ anywhere this holiday; I'm staying home."
questions.explanation: 现在进行时表将来否定 → am not going。

questions.stem: "I ____ the night train to the coast tonight; I have already booked a bed."
questions.explanation: 已定安排(已订卧铺)→ 现在进行时表将来 am taking;take a train 比 catch a flight 更适合进行时表将来(catch 有瞬间性,进行时不地道)。

questions.stem: "____ they coming with us tomorrow?"
questions.explanation: 现在进行时表将来疑问 → Are they coming?

questions.stem: "The guide ____ us at the gate in ten minutes."
questions.explanation: 近期已定 → is meeting。

questions.stem: "We ____ out for dinner tonight to celebrate."
questions.explanation: 今晚已定安排 → are eating。

questions.stem: "She ____ back home on Sunday evening."
questions.explanation: 已定行程 → is coming。

questions.stem: "I ____ a new bag for the trip this afternoon."
questions.explanation: 今天下午计划 → am buying。

questions.stem: "They ____ the museum at two tomorrow, not three."
questions.explanation: 已约时间 → are touring。

questions.stem: "We ____ in Lima for three nights before moving on."
questions.explanation: 已定行程 → are staying。

questions.stem: "My sister ____ married next month."
questions.explanation: 已定安排 → is getting married。

questions.stem: "____ you flying or driving to the coast next week?"
questions.explanation: 问已定方式 → Are you flying…?

questions.stem: "The plane ____ off in half an hour, so board now."
questions.explanation: 近期已定 → is taking off。
